name: FireWatch
tagline: Watches for wildfires near your home and only speaks up when something changes
description: Point it at the area you live in and it keeps an eye on live wildfire reporting for that patch of map. body:
## What it does

Point it at the area you live in and it keeps an eye on live wildfire reporting for that patch of map. It checks in several times a day rather than sitting idle, and stays quiet unless something has actually started or shifted close enough to matter, so the alert you get is worth reading. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @RobautoAI shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
